parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Myofibrils in striated muscle consist of contractile units called sarcomeres.

When an impulse stimulates striated muscles to contract, calcium ions are released from the sarcoplasmic reticulum.

Describe how the release of calcium ions leads to the contraction of a sarcomere.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The many-banded krait, *Bungarus multicinctus*, is a venomous snake.

Fig. 3.1 shows a many-banded krait.

{{figure:figure_3_1.png}}

Fig. 3.1

The venom from the many-banded krait contains bungarotoxin. In mammals that are bitten by this snake, the venom acts at the neuromuscular junction, causing muscle paralysis (loss of muscle function).

Suggest how bungarotoxin may cause muscle paralysis.
